part2.title: Describe a conversation that you still remember well.
bullets: where and when it took place
part2.closing: and explain why that conversation has stayed in your mind.
follow_up: Have you spoken to that person since then?
Would you say anything differently now?

items.prompt: What makes a conversation worth remembering years later?
Do people speak more openly to strangers than to those close to them?
Will everyday conversation suffer as written messages take over?
